name: one-shot-apps
title: One Shot Apps
description: Create app groups and launch or quit them all at once
author: yasinkavakli

commands.name: launch-group
commands.title: Launch Group
commands.description: Open all apps in a group with a single command

commands.name: quit-group
commands.title: Quit Group
commands.description: Gracefully quit all apps in a group

commands.name: manage-groups
commands.title: Manage Groups
commands.description: Create, edit, and delete your app groups

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
